W_RNG_SRC_SUB: the chip's noise circuit is off by default. this firmware switches it on at boot and reports it here.
W_RNG_WHY1_B: 5000 numbers, 100 piles, about 50 each. chi square scores the spread. honest noise is in the fair range 499 of 500 runs.
W_RNG_WHY2_B: a formula passes every spread test, so the bars cannot name the source. camera or dice are folded into your keys.
W_RNG_NOSRC_B: with no source these numbers are a formula, and a formula still passes. nothing to audit until the source is back.
W_RNG_RETRY: honest noise misses once in 500 runs. run it again.
